annotations.text:
THIS ONE RESPONDS — click into the artboard first.

· Click either question on the landing screen to answer it.
· Hover a row in the answer list — its edge and node in Fig. 1 light up, and vice versa. That linkage is the whole thesis: the answer is not recalled, it is assembled from those edges.
· "← ask another" returns to the landing screen.

Two questions are wired, both from your captured responses: Logic Tensor Networks (3 facts) and hallucination (11 facts). The second is there on purpose — it is the case that proves the layout survives a long answer.

There is no network here, so nothing reaches Aura. Latency figures are placeholders; every name, arXiv id and count is real.

STILL OPEN

· Third screen — the entity explorer — not drawn yet. Worth doing once you know whether you want it as a separate page or as clicking a node here.
· No error state yet: unresolved entity, empty result, service down. The API returns a status field for these.
· Mobile width untested.

A — INSTRUMENT (not chosen)

Dense, monospaced, dark. Facts as a table, provenance in the corner. Matched the project's engineering character but read as competent tooling rather than something you would screenshot.

C — GRAPH-FIRST (not chosen)

Full-bleed canvas, answer floating over a dimmed neighbourhood. The most memorable image, but the answer text competed with the graph and it drifted toward Neo4j Bloom.

Worth revisiting if the entity explorer becomes its own screen — this is what that screen probably wants to look like.
